notes:
Composed of {脱|だつ} (remove) and {色|しょく} (color). Most commonly encountered in the context of hair bleaching, but also used for fabric, chemicals, and industrial processes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{脱色|だっしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bleach hair
- {脱色|だっしょく}{剤|ざい}: bleaching agent
- {脱色|だっしょく}⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧: bleaching action
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{脱色|だっしょく}: natural fading/bleaching

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{漂白|ひょうはく}→漂白：16995_hyouhaku⟧: bleaching — more commonly used for laundry and cleaning
- ⟦{退色|たいしょく}→退色：20872_taishoku⟧: fading, discoloration — gradual color loss over time, not intentional
- ⟦{染色|せんしょく}→染色：15817_senshoku⟧: dyeing — the opposite process of adding color
